nameOrigin: initials for the four seasons: Summer, Autumn, Winter, Spring

pokedexEntries.bk: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

pokedexEntries.wh: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
